description: Source code for USB serial over device (CDC) implementation using ChibiOS, defining USB descriptors, endpoint configurations, and event handlers.

methods.name: get_descriptor
methods.description: Handles GET_DESCRIPTOR requests, returning appropriate USB descriptors based on request parameters.

methods.name: usb_event
methods.description: Handles global USB events such as configuration, reset, suspend, wakeup, and stall.

methods.name: sof_handler
methods.description: Handles Start Of Frame (SOF) USB events.
